exposure: Treatment group (transvaginal repair vs. hysteroscopic resection)
cohort: Women with niche associated postmenstrual spotting
finding: Both transvaginal repair and hysteroscopic resection improved postmenstrual spotting and anatomical structures of uterine lower segments with niches, but transvaginal repair was better in thickening the residual myometrium while hysteroscopic resection had shorter operative time, hospitalization duration, fewer complications, and lower costs.
